page.layout: One printed page, single text column in the centre; running head at top; no marginal notes on the printed page (the faint text at the right edge is show-through from the facing page and is left out); no catchword, no signature; the digitiser's banner at the foot is left out.

main_text.p: Fures! Sed frustrà: Nam priusquam foribus alicujus efferatur Pharus, tuta jam dudum subiit cum spoliis pirata. Domum veni‐tur tandem: Impatiens moræ lassitudo, oblatum fortè circa fo‐cum procumbit in sedile: Et pro‐tinus alto sepulta somno crapula, aperit sibi ructibus & runcis spi‐raculum, crastinis demum ac pe‐rendinis medenda repotiis.
main_text.head: Quæstio XVIII.

p.i: An indoles agilis & popularis, an sedata &, ut vocant, Stoi‐ca sit præoptanda?

main_text.p: IN motu, in strepitu, in celebritate Vita est: Mortis imaginem habent Torpor & Sopor & deserta Silentia: Et verò Mors ipsa

page.notes: The initial I is a large woodcut ornamental letter, joined to "N" as "IN". Lines of the heading "Quæstio XVIII." are as printed. Show-through from the facing page is present at the right edge and was not transcribed.
